column3: [R4:gap1-1] Strategy-2 bare substring containment picks a superstring-titled sibling — or an entirely different owned record — as the Discogs play-count write target, and misses exactly-owned records on decorated Shazam titles

[R4:gap1-2] SideIndex.from_tracklist locates the track by exact lower().strip() equality — routine Shazam-vs-Discogs title divergence (remaster/live/feat suffixes, ’ vs ', NFD accents) silently forfeits the album-completion Play Count and blanks t…
[R4:data-3] Last.fm love targets last identified track, not the closer that armed it — replay or FALLBACK swap after the closer loves the wrong track/artist (executed repro)
[R4:gap1-3] Shazam attribution swing to an owned release whose tracklist ends with the playing track mints a one-track split-off session that phantom-credits that record's Play Count
[R4:gap1-4] Strategy 1 accepts the first owned release among 25 loose-search candidates with no title cross-check — a similar-titled owned album can become the instance_id write target

[R4:gap3-1] B-4's uncached DB-tier carve-out revokes the album-split detector's documented same-release-id premise: one transient blip on an album's first resolve causes a spurious split, and in the closer-first case silently loses the Play Count …
[R4:data-4] Same-release re-drop within the 45s silence window merges two complete playthroughs into one session — Play Count undercounts by one (split blind to equal release ids)
[R4:data-1] #163 finalize retry re-runs the full read-modify-write, double-crediting Play Count when a POST outcome is ambiguous (applied but response lost)

[R4:data-2] Shutdown cancels an album-split credit mid-write: the inline finalize in the recognition leg is cancelled before tracker.drain(), which only covers _bg_tasks — silent half-credit (CONC-1 class, split path)

[R4:err-1] Transient 429/network error during _build_result's lazy release fetch is swallowed per-field and the degraded result (no cover, empty tracklist) is cached session-long as a Discogs hit, silently forfeiting the album's Play Count / Last …
[R4:err-3] is_transient() classifies HTTP 401/403/404 as transient — a revoked Discogs token or wrong username silently stops play-count accrual forever, logged only as INFO "(transient)"
[R4:err-4] A transient MusicBrainz outage is flattened to None by CoverArtFallback's outer except, and resolve() caches that None as the album's FALLBACK payload for the whole session

[R4:stab-2] Collection index and album cache never expire within a process lifetime; the 'restarts daily' premise is unimplemented, so records added to Discogs during long uptimes are silently never Play-Count credited until a restart
[R4:err-2] Stale shared-pool comments + false "caller has no further retry" log; #163's finalize retry burns all 3 attempts inside a >10s Retry-After window (loss itself already accepted in #88)
[R4:stab-1] No music gate on recognition: every silent chunk is Shazam-POSTed (~8,640/day idle), despite the silence verdict being computed one line earlier

[R4:conc-1] Rebuild-loop device re-resolution reads PortAudio's import-time snapshot: comment and #164 test promise late-enumeration/re-plug recovery the library cannot deliver; a device absent at import or re-plugged to a new card index leaves ca…

[R4:conc-3] Recognition commits are not gated on the silence detector's music state: sub-threshold audio yields sessions SESSION_ENDED can never end — overnight stuck card, wrong/merged Discogs credits (album-split partially recovers), lost loves;…
[R4:conc-4] commit() logs 'Now playing' and returns True after the tracker's CONC-6 stale drop, contradicting its documented False-on-discard contract

[R4:err-5] Per-chunk 'ShazamIO recognition failed' WARNING is unthrottled — a fast-failing network outage writes ~8,640 identical journal lines/day, the flood class #178/PCONC-4 throttled in capture.py

[R4:ops-1] Fresh install per setup guide is dead: Imager's default "Raspberry Pi OS (64-bit)" is now Trixie/Python 3.13, where shazamio's pydub dep cannot import (audioop removed) — pip succeeds, every recognition chunk fails silently as a miss
[R4:gap2-1] discogs_live_check.py verifies only play_count_field_name; a misconfigured last_played_field_name passes every check green
[R4:ops-2] pi-setup-guide display config and screen blanking target the legacy X11/firmware stack; inert on every OS the guide's Imager step can flash (Trixie now, Bookworm as Legacy)

[R4:ops-3] Doc's only remedy for the boot-time session race (After=graphical-session.target in a system unit) is a verified silent no-op; StartLimitBurst=5/RestartSec=10 lets the race exhaust retries in ~50s
[R4:sec-1] Discogs user token leaks verbatim into persistent logs via discogs_client exception text on any network blip (bypasses _redact_url)
[R4:gap2-2] discogs_live_check.py prints the Discogs user token verbatim on library-half network errors — discogs_client 2.9 carries the token in the URL query and fail() echoes raw exception text
[R4:gap2-3] discogs_live_check.py resolves config.yaml from the CWD while resolving imports from the repo root — run from anywhere else it fails with the misleading 'Copy config.example.yaml' message
[R4:ops-4] pi-setup-guide §8b/§8d (and the helper's own docstring) still describe the pre-S-3 "prints session key to terminal" behavior; script now writes a 0600 file
[R4:disp-1] Status-strip labels are muted-on-solid-surface, brighter than the DISP-2 clamp target — WCAG 4.5:1 fails on nearly all covers (measured 3.56–4.44:1)

[R4:arch-6] Renderer _spawn's done callback never retrieves task exceptions — escaping OSErrors (e.g. worn-SD stat/unlink) surface only as detached GC-time 'Task exception was never retrieved', unlike the CONC-3-fixed tracker registry
[R4:disp-2] Static screens settle on the quantized lerp palette — final exact-target frame never rendered (IDLE/ERROR, and now-playing under reduced_motion)
[R4:test-1] run()'s chunk-dispatch (silence.process/recognizer.enqueue) is unpinned: a mutant dropping every chunk passes 948/948 — residual of the #138/TQ-7 remediation
[R4:test-2] Retry helper's raise branch unpinned: a re-raise mutant in _finalize_write_with_retry passes 948/948, leaving the #163 raise-as-failure contract unguarded
[R4:test-3] Untested Discogs database tier + _build_result cover/label branches: triple mutation (tier deleted, image preference inverted, catno filter dropped) passes 948/948
[R4:gap3-2] SEC-4's _DOWNLOAD_DEADLINE_SECONDS and PCONC-2's _RECOGNIZE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS lack MUT-9-style shipped-value pins — both mutable to 10^9 with 948/948 green (executed)
[R4:gap3-3] B-22/STAB-5 decode-path _cover_version bump (renderer.py:1490) is unpinned: mutation to `pass` survives 948/948

[R4:test-4] README.md:24 and architecture.md:834 document acrcloud/audd as valid recognition.backend values that config.py's CRIT-2 gate rejects at startup (config.example.yaml alone was reconciled by #93)
[R4:test-5] DisplayRenderer.run() (lines 519-541) has zero coverage: QUIT/ESC stop paths, dirty-reset ordering, and 30/10fps cadence all unpinned
[R4:test-6] testing-guide.md:104 claims whole suite runs "in well under a second"; measured 5.15s at 948 tests
[R4:arch-1] Commit-path epoch invariant is ~6 hand-placed point checks with a 5-issue recurrence history; no structural guard for the new awaits v1.6/v1.7 will add

[R4:arch-2] No persistence layer exists yet for v1.6/v1.7 roadmap needs, and the finalize path's latch-guard pattern is hand-mirrored twice (future third copy risk) — real but zero present runtime impact
[R4:arch-3] v1.6 idle-screen pre-work: land seams first — idle-is-static invariant, an idle-time cover-fetch entry point, and an app-layer idle-content feed (no current defect)
[R4:arch-4] Bounded LRU cache implemented twice (renderer._BoundedCache + hand-rolled copy in MetadataResolver), already subtly diverged on replace semantics
[R4:arch-5] Three variants of one summarizing-throttle pattern hand-rolled across capture.py (plus two distinct idioms elsewhere); the -inf monotonic-seed subtlety documented twice
